page_title: ESP 0-0 LEV | Espanyol v Levante 27/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Crossbar! Carlos Alvarez (Levante) picks up a precise pass and produces a bullet of a strike from distance that smashes against the crossbar. It could have been a brilliant goal.
90+4' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
90+4' Although Manolo Gonzalez (Espanyol) is just on the bench, Mateo Busquets has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.

90+3' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Marko Dmitrovic was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save. Now Levante have a corner.
90+2' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' A pass into the box finds Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Marko Dmitrovic denies him.
88' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
88' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
86' We are about to witness a substitution. Tai Abed (Levante) is replacing Victor Garcia.
85' Substitution. Urko Gonzalez did his best and is replaced by Pol Lozano (Espanyol).
85' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Charles Pickel (Espanyol) replacing Kike Garcia.
82' Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
81' The game is interrupted as Victor Garcia (Levante) is flagged offside.
80' Antoniu Roca (Espanyol) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul. Levante win a free kick.
78' Karl Etta Eyong (Levante) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Mateo Busquets didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.

77' Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) picks up the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort that sails well over the crossbar and ends in the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
76' Levante take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
75' Matias Moreno (Levante) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
74' Matias Moreno (Levante) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
73' Mateo Busquets shows a yellow card to Matias Moreno (Levante) for a tough tackle.
72' Carlos Alvarez (Levante) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Pablo Martinez Andres.
72' Luis Castro decides to make a substitution. Carlos Espi will be replaced by Karl Etta Eyong (Levante).
71' Today's referee Mateo Busquets rightly decides to book Exposito (Espanyol) for his harsh tackle.
70' Mateo Busquets shows a yellow card to Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) for his blatant foul.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pere Milla trots off the pitch and is replaced by Antoniu Roca (Espanyol).
69' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Mateo Busquets saw the whole situation. Levante will take a free kick.
68' Espanyol are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
63' Dela (Levante) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
62' Dela (Levante) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
62' The referee blows his whistle as Pere Milla (Espanyol) was too aggressive in his challenge. Levante will take a free kick near the side line.
60' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Iker Losada (Levante) will replace Fran Cortes.
60' A substitution has been made. Ugo Raghouber is replaced by Kervin Arriaga (Levante).
58' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to substitute Cyril Ngonge and he is replaced by Tyrhys Dolan (Espanyol).
58' It's time for a substitution. Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol) comes on in place of Ramon Terrats.
57' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Fran Cortes (Levante) but poses no threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.

56' Exposito (Espanyol) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Mathew Ryan scrambling, but it flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.

53' Pere Milla (Espanyol)'s poor effort is easily saved by Mathew Ryan. He connects well with a cross, but mistimes it a little, and it heads towards the middle of the target and straight into the grateful hands of the goalkeeper.
53' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) produces a cross from the resulting free kick far from the goal, but there's no one to really attack the ball and the goalkeeper gathers easily.
52' Exposito (Espanyol) makes a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Levante.
50' A corner kick by Levante is thwarted by the well prepared Marko Dmitrovic (Espanyol).
49' Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. Levante are awarded the free kick.
48' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.

47' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. Free kick. Levante will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
46' The attendance for today's match is 25526.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Espanyol fail to score from a corner as Mathew Ryan (Levante) leaps to collect the ball.
42' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
42' It's going to be a corner kick.

41' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman points to the corner flag, Espanyol are going to take it.

40' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) leaps highest in the penalty area to get on the end of a cross from the set piece, and he produces a promising goal-bound header towards the middle of the goal, but Mathew Ryan pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
39' Mateo Busquets interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Dela (Levante). That's a free kick to Espanyol.
38' Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
36' The linesman signals that Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

35' Manu Sanchez (Levante) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mateo Busquets no option but to blow his whistle. It's a free kick to Espanyol, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
34' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
32' The ref blows his whistle to halt play for an injury that he’s actually picked up!
31' Omar El Hilali (Espanyol) sends a long ball in, but Mathew Ryan comfortably gathers the ball.
30' None of the Espanyol players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
29' Espanyol failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The referee signals a corner kick to Espanyol.
28' Levante seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
23' Ugo Raghouber (Levante) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for an infringement. Espanyol have a free kick.
21' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Kike Garcia (Espanyol) heads on.
19' Exposito (Espanyol) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
19' Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) makes a slide tackle, but referee Mateo Busquets blows for a foul. Espanyol win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
16' Dela (Levante) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
13' Flag goes up against Cyril Ngonge (Espanyol) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

11' Jeremy Toljan (Levante) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Mateo Busquets with no other option than to blow for a foul. Espanyol are awarded a free kick.
9' Dela (Levante) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
6' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Levante comes to nothing.

6' Victor Garcia (Levante) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it towards the top left corner. Unfortunately for him, Marko Dmitrovic makes a great save to stop his effort. The referee blows his whistle, Levante are awarded a corner kick.
5' Exposito (Espanyol) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
4' Ramon Terrats (Espanyol) trips an opposition player and Mateo Busquets signals a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Levante.
3' Kike Garcia (Espanyol) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Mathew Ryan, who pulls off a stunning save!

2' Carlos Espi (Levante) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. It's a free kick to Espanyol, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.

The players are on the pitch and Espanyol will have the kick-off.
